name: City Real Estate Taxes
reason: The City's property tax: a tax the City levies, counted under § 8.08.

name: Real Estate Transfer
reason: The realty transfer tax: a tax the City levies, counted under § 8.08.

name: Earned Income Tax
reason: The earned income tax: a tax the City levies, counted under § 8.08.

name: Local Services Tax
reason: The local services tax: a tax the City levies, counted under § 8.08.

name: Payment in Lieu of Taxes
reason: A voluntary payment by tax-exempt owners, not a tax the City levies.

name: Penalty Current Tax
reason: Penalties on late payment of current taxes: a charge on top of the tax, not a tax rate or levy.

name: Lien Interest & Costs
reason: Interest and collection costs on tax liens: a charge for collecting, not a tax.

name: Utility Tax Refund
reason: The state's public utility realty tax refund: a payment from the state, not a tax the City levies.

name: Real Estate Tax Lien Proc
reason: Proceeds from selling delinquent tax liens: a one-time sale of an asset, which § 8.08 leaves out.
